findings.title: createPatch allocates a quadratic LCS table with no size guard
findings.why: diffArrays builds a Uint32Array of (n+1)*(m+1) entries for the differing middle of the two arrays, and fills each cell with a deep jsonEqual. Two large arrays with a differing middle, for example tens of thousands of records each, throw a RangeError or run out of memory, or take a very long time. This is a library that other services import, and it has no fallback such as emitting a single replace op above a size threshold.
